attributes.action: Make Criminal Background Checks Mandatory for All UK Dating Apps
attributes.additional_details: Every year, people unknowingly begin relationships with individuals convicted of serious domestic abuse, sexual or violent offences. I believe dating apps should be legally required to verify users' identities and carry out criminal background checks under a Government-approved legal framework. This would help prevent those convicted of specified serious offences from using dating apps and improve public safety through stronger safeguards.
attributes.background: Introduce legislation requiring all UK dating apps to carry out mandatory identity verification and criminal background checks before users can create or keep a dating profile, preventing those convicted of specified serious violent, domestic abuse and sexual offences from using these platforms.
